In the setup checkouts under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-l01-l20/worktrees (L05-junit-framework-fix = 2b484caa962ad9b0d9a6af5d2c25100b6a8f4ef6, L05-junit-framework-parent = bbeb7900fa76b6fc00e36e0bea05747066b4a2ec; standalone depth-1 clones, because JUnit's build reads git metadata), runs the upstream Gradle build through $O/scripts/L05-gradle.sh: Gradle 9.8.0 (zip checked against services.gradle.org and the wrapper's distributionSha256Sum) on JDK 25.0.5, toolchains JDK 17, 21, 24.0.2 and 25 from the caches, --no-build-cache and --no-scan, retries 0 and predictive test selection off.
